title: 第14章 商议婚事第15章 迎新逛庙会
content_zh:
“喂，妈，我跟哥哥已经回来了，现在在炎君家里，晚上我们吃饭不回去啦。”女帝拨通了她母亲的电话。
“回来啦？不回来吃晚饭？那行我跟你爸来陈家吃晚饭，顺便跟炎君父母商量点事。行，就这样，挂了昂。”
“啥？？”女帝一脸懵逼，“老大，炎君，我爸妈要过来吃饭。”
“叔叔阿姨要过来？好嘞，我这就去跟我爸讲一声，让他亲自下厨。”炎君刚出院子就遇上勾肩搭背的邪帝神君。
“干嘛去，女帝呢？叫她回家了。”
“神君大哥，叔叔阿姨说要来吃晚饭，我这准备去跟爸妈说一声。”
“啊，这样子啊，那行。”
炎君来到陈家家主的院落，“爸妈，我们回来了，女帝跟神君大哥也在，盛叔叔说晚上要过来吃饭。”
“哦？那敢情好，这不得我亲自下厨，哈哈哈哈。”
“对了，阿姨说还要商量点事。”
......
晚上盛家家主跟他妻子来到陈家，陈家家主亲自接见来到院落。
“神君，让妈好好看看你，有没有受伤。”神君母亲对着神君一顿嘘寒问暖。天底下哪有母亲不关心自己孩子的。
“阿姨，你就放心吧。神君我罩着的不会有啥事的。”邪帝拍了拍胸脯。
“邪帝你说什么，谁要你罩着了。”神君有点无语。
“哈哈哈哈哈，来，天翼兄，湘云弟妹快坐。”神君的父亲盛天翼，母亲阮湘云。
“哈哈哈哈，好久没见纵横兄跟素月姐了。”邪帝的父亲陈纵横，母亲林素月。
女帝与冰帝坐在一起，女帝旁边是炎君，冰帝旁边是邪帝，邪帝旁边是神君。
“也好久没见冰帝妹子了，越来越水灵了啊。不愧被称为当世宇宙第一美女啊。”阮湘云打趣道。
“阿姨过奖了。”冰帝笑了笑。

“邪帝你啊平时在外面跟神君俩人好好照应照应。”
“好的叔叔，有我在没人动的了神君的。也不会让他在外面勾搭什么小姑娘的哈哈哈哈。”神君满头黑线。
“来来来，快尝尝我的菜，可都是我亲手做的。”陈纵横组织大家动筷。
“纵横大哥做的菜肯定好吃啊。”
晚饭进行到一半，酒过三巡。
陈纵横开口了：“天翼兄啊，你们说要商量事情，是什么事啊？”
盛天翼笑了笑，看了眼阮湘云。
阮湘云说道：“哎呀，是这样的。也不是什么大事，你们看，炎君跟女帝也不小了，之前我们这个年纪的时候都成婚了。”炎君跟女帝越听越不对劲，“今晚主要是想跟你们商量下这俩孩子的婚事。”
此话一出，邪帝干饭干到一半被噎住了，“咳咳咳咳咳。”
众人目光看向邪帝。“我没事，你们继续，哈哈，咳咳咳，吃太快噎着了。”
冰帝给邪帝倒了杯水。
“商量婚事？我觉得可以啊。”林素月此时来了兴致，“确实也可以成婚了，我也想早点抱孙子呢。”
一旁的炎君跟女帝疯狂向邪帝神君冰帝三人使眼色，好家伙，三人直接吃饭，看都不看他俩一眼。这俩人俩眼泪汪汪。
“爸妈，叔叔阿姨，这还不是大事啊？这会不会太早了啊，太早了吧。是吧哥哥，会不会太早了，哥哥都还没结婚，我这个当弟弟的怎么能先呢？”炎君缓缓开口，话题扯向了邪帝。
“对啊，哥哥都还没结婚，我这个妹妹怎么能先呢？
妈，你快问问哥哥跟圣君姐姐现在怎么样？我跟你讲，最近哥哥都惹姐姐不高兴了哦。
不然你看今晚姐姐怎么不在啊？妈，你快管管你儿子吧！再不管我嫂子你儿媳都要没了!”女帝直接跟上，转移话题。
“在说你俩的事，别扯你们哥哥。”冰帝喝着汤淡淡开口。
邪帝心想：老弟啊，你扯我的婚事不就是找老大麻烦么。
炎君也意识到了不对劲。
content_en:
"Hey, Mom, my brother and I have come back. We are now at Yanjun's house. We won't be going back for dinner tonight." The empress dialed her mother's phone number.
"You're back? Not coming back for dinner? Well, your father and I will come to Chen's house for dinner and discuss something with Yanjun's parents. Okay, that's it, I'm done."
"What??" the empress looked confused, "Boss, Mr. Yan, my parents are coming over for dinner."
"Uncle and aunt are coming over? Okay, I'm going to tell my dad right now and let him cook in person." As soon as Yan Jun left the yard, he met the Evil Emperor and God Lord, who was arm-in-arm.
"Why are you going, where is the Empress? Tell her to go home."
"Brother Shenjun, my uncle and aunt said they are coming for dinner. I am going to tell my parents."
"Ah, that's it, that's fine."
Yan Jun came to the courtyard of the head of the Chen family, "Mom and Dad, we are back. The Empress and Brother Shenjun are also here. Uncle Sheng said he would come over for dinner in the evening."
"Oh? That's great, but I have to cook it myself, hahahaha."
"By the way, Auntie said that we still need to discuss something."
...
In the evening, the head of the Sheng family and his wife came to the Chen family. The head of the Chen family personally received them in the courtyard.
"Shenjun, let mom take a good look at you to see if you are injured." Shenjun's mother greeted him with greetings. There is no mother in the world who doesn't care about her children.
"Auntie, don't worry. I'll cover the Lord God and nothing will happen to you." The Evil Emperor patted his chest.
"Evil Emperor, what are you talking about? Who wants you to protect me?" Shenjun was a little speechless.
"Hahahahaha, come on, brother Tianyi, brother and sister Xiangyun, sit down quickly." Shenjun's father, Sheng Tianyi, and his mother, Ruan Xiangyun.
"Hahahaha, I haven't seen brother Zongheng and sister Suyue for a long time." The evil emperor's father, Chen Zongheng, and his mother, Lin Suyue.
The Empress and the Ice Emperor sit together. Next to the Empress is the Flame Lord, next to the Ice Emperor is the Evil Emperor, and next to the Evil Emperor is the Divine Lord.
"It's been a long time since I saw the Ice Emperor girl. She's becoming more and more beautiful. She deserves to be called the most beautiful woman in the universe." Ruan Xiangyun joked.
"Auntie, thank you." Ice Emperor smiled.
"Evil Emperor, you usually take good care of me outside with Shen Jun."
"Okay uncle, no one will touch Shenjun while I'm here. I won't let him hook up with some little girl outside, hahahaha." Shenjun's head was full of black lines.
"Come on, come on, come and try my dishes. They are all made by me." Chen Zongheng organized everyone to use chopsticks.
"The food cooked by Brother Zongheng must be delicious."
Halfway through dinner, we drank for three rounds.
Chen Zongheng spoke: "Brother Tianyi, you said you wanted to discuss something, what is it about?"
Sheng Tianyi smiled and glanced at Ruan Xiangyun.
Ruan Xiangyun said: "Oh, that's it. It's not a big deal. You see, Yan Jun and the Empress are not young anymore. They were married when we were our age." The more Yan Jun and the Empress heard, the more they felt something was wrong. "Tonight, I mainly want to discuss with you the marriage of these two children."
As soon as he said this, the Evil Emperor choked halfway through his meal, "Cough cough cough cough."
Everyone looked at the Evil Emperor. "I'm fine, you continue, haha, cough, cough, cough, I ate too fast and choked."
The Ice Emperor poured a glass of water for the Evil Emperor.
"Discussing marriage? I think it's okay." Lin Suyue became interested at this time, "It's true that we can get married. I also want to have a grandson soon."
Yan Jun and the Empress on the side winked wildly at the Evil Emperor, God, Ice Emperor and the three of them, "Good guys, the three of them just ate without even looking at them." The two men burst into tears.
"Mom, Dad, uncles and aunts, isn't this a big deal? Isn't it too early? Isn't it too early? Brother, isn't it too early? My brother is not married yet, how can I, the younger brother, be the first?" Yan Jun spoke slowly, and the topic turned to the Evil Emperor.
"Yes, my brother is not married yet, how can I, my sister, get married first?
Mom, please ask your brother and sister Shengjun how they are doing now.? Let me tell you, my brother has made his sister unhappy recently.
Otherwise, why wouldn't your sister be here tonight? Mom, please take care of your son! If you don't care about my sister-in-law, your daughter-in-law will be gone!" The empress followed directly and changed the subject.
"I'm talking about you two, don't talk about your brother. "The Ice Emperor said calmly while drinking the soup.
The Evil Emperor thought to himself: Brother, aren't you just asking for trouble for the boss by asking about my marriage?
Yanjun also realized something was wrong.
